description: Supernovic is a team passionate about space exploration, technology, and storytelling. We aim to transform NASA’s forgotten and abandoned space hardware into engaging stories that help people understand the missions, science, and discoveries behind these remarkable artifacts.
summary: NovaQuest is a website for Storytelling of NASA's discarded equipment. The website has multiple features such as NovaMap (an interactive 3D map of the solar system) , NovaQuest (An interactive game for kids), Novabase (A large library of spacecrafts) and Memoir (Documentary about spacecrafts). This project aims at making information about inactive or even active spacecrafts more accessible to the general public and make learning about space easier and fun for kids!!
details:
Novaquest is a browser-based platform bringing forgotten space missions back to life in four parts:

  • NovaBase Explorer: A searchable database of space hardware and missions regardless of weather they're active or inactive. Every spacecraft entry is built from a fixed ten-section template, which is also the educational spine of the product:
  1. What is it?
  2. How does it work?
  3. Why is it important?
  4. Current or last known status
  5. Imagery and scientific visualisations
  6. Official archives and verified sources
  7. Mission timeline
  8. Institutional stakeholders
  9. Spacecraft 3D model
  10. The top ten people who helped develop the mission
  • NovaMap: a NASA Eyes-style 3D solar system that computes planet positions from JPL Keplerian elements for any date from 1800 to 2050, with time-warp, surface landing sites, interstellar spacecraft and NOVA, a source-grounded guide.
  • NovaQuest: an interactive storytelling game which takes the user on a mission to different parts of space such as moon, interstellar space or mars in order to retrieve or repair spacecrafts but in order to successfully complete the mission the user has to time travel and recreate that mission and launch it into space!
  • Memoir: short animated documentaries of abandoned equipment on moon and mars that tell the real history of the mission and talk about the discoveries that it made , such as the Surveyor 3 film.

BENEFITS

It is easy to understand for people that don't know much about space. It provides an interactive experiences such as a game and an interactive map. It is easy to navigate through. when someone wants to find out about spacecrafts and their stories, descriptions and data they collected they can just search novabase and if they prefer to not read then they can watch memoir documentaries. It also provides visual 3d presentation of spacecrafts related to space and the interactive game teaches the user about all different parts used in the spacecraft and the user has a launching experience.

INTENDED IMPACT

It targets the gap between people interested into space and professionals who work in the fields. This project focuses on making complex terms easy to understand for everyone and it aims to become a reliable resource for space scientists. For students it turns engineering into a playable problem; for educators a free, citable resource for teaching source evaluation; for the public, a preserved record of finished missions with verifiable sources.

TOOLS AND TECHNOLOGY

  • Languages: JavaScript/JSX, Python 3, SQL, HTML, CSS.
  • Frontend: React 19, React Router 7, Three.js r186, Tween.js, Tailwind 4, Vite 7, Firebase SDK, Web Audio API.
  • Backend: Flask 3, SQLAlchemy 2, PostgreSQL 16 (Docker) with SQLite fallback, bcrypt and PyJWT.
  • Data: NASA/JPL archives and APIs, Wikipedia, Wikidata, Keplerian elements and Horizons trajectories.
  • Quality: pytest, node:test, Puppeteer, oxlint and custom database audits. Standard
  • WebGL 2 laptops were used; no special hardware was required.

CREATIVITY

  • We have focused on our problem statement Abandoned but not Forgotten: storytelling about NASA's discarded equipment on moon and mars Greatly
  • To make school age kids understand more about space in an easy manner we implemented an interactive game where the player time travels and makes the mission by themselves and then witnesses the launch and sees what discovery the mission made
  • We implemented a large database which gives complete information on many Spacecrafts in an easy to navigate manner but these days kids like to see more than read so we also implemented an animated documentary in memoir
  • We also implemented a 3D map where user can see the spacecraft's 3D model in relative to space so that user can digitally travel in space by themselves!

FACTORS CONSIDERED

  • Complexity in searching about more information of spacecrafts in the millions of sites and documentation on the internet and trying to bring all of it into one website to ease the search
  • The gap of knowledge between general public and the professionals working in space. Getting to know more about space usually requires user to understand some pretty complex terminology that space tech professionals use , this site tries to use easy language and tries to define everything for individuals who know nothing about space
  • Interactivity : this project also focuses on making it interesting for kids and space enthusiasts so that they can explore space and see the spacecraft by themselves
